verification: Native play click with separate ad and player listeners; locally recorded WebM decoding and clock advancement.
Pause/resume, seeking, fullscreen, nested frames, frame-local HTTP redirects and origin/storage.
Scripted same-host server redirects stopped before first hop; native links/forms and browser history/reload preserved.
Stricter server sandbox preserved; policy enable/pause/disable behavior and transactional failure/rollback/retry.
Desktop and narrow control layouts inspected. Full blocker, existing popup and blocked-tab cleanup regressions passed.
boundaries: Real links/forms may legitimately follow HTTP redirects.
Script-only page navigation and frame-to-top controls are blocked. A player depending on those actions may need the guard disabled.
A denied frame navigation throws a browser security exception and can interrupt the current handler.
Service-worker-generated/CacheStorage document responses can bypass network header policies; page-hook tampering and restricted injection remain limits.
Local tests do not establish universal live-site or DRM compatibility. Firefox and old browser binaries were not tested.

safety.fixtures: Owned loopback only; external deny proxies; generated canvas/video data in memory. Chrome visible for media, navigation and full blocker checks; Edge headless.
safety.copiedFixtureOverrides: Existing Reddit hostname alias and blocked-tab fixture rules only in disposable test packages.

notes: Initial unguarded WebM readiness timed out; explicit preload/load of the recorded Blob fixed the fixture. The attempt is retained.
